subject: E-Commerce
title: The Amazon Effect on Everything
description: A 60-second lesson on The Amazon Effect on Everything.

hook.text: Patients now expect 'Amazon-like' experiences from doctors. Students want it from universities. Everyone compares.

buildup.text: Amazon reset expectations for speed, convenience, and selection across all industries, not just retail.

discovery.text: Banks built apps because of Amazon. Hospitals added online booking because of Amazon. The ripple is everywhere.

twist.text: The 'Amazon Effect' may be its biggest legacy. Not the products, but the expectation of instant everything.

climax.text: Amazon didn't just change shopping. It changed what people tolerate. Slow, friction-filled services feel broken.

punchline.text: Not just a store. Amazon reset the world's expectations for everything.

quiz.question: What is the 'Amazon Effect' beyond retail?
options: Raised expectations for speed and convenience in all industries
